description: This file defines the 'Tab' class for managing browser tab interactions within Playwright, including event handling, snapshot capturing, navigation, and modal/dialog management.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a browser tab, managing its state, events, snapshots, and interactions.

methods.name: forPage
methods.description: Returns the Tab instance associated with a given Playwright page.

methods.name: collectConsoleMessages
methods.description: Collects console messages and errors from a Playwright page.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the tab's last known title.

methods.name: lastTitle
methods.description: Returns the last recorded title of the tab.

methods.name: isCurrentTab
methods.description: Checks if this tab is the current active tab.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the page to reach a specific load state.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the tab to a specified URL.

methods.name: consoleMessages
methods.description: Retrieves console messages, optionally filtered by error type.

methods.name: requests
methods.description: Returns the set of requests made by the page.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the tab's current state.

methods.name: refLocator
methods.description: Resolves a locator based on element and ref.

methods.name: refLocators
methods.description: Resolves multiple locators based on elements and refs.

methods.name: waitForTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a specified timeout, considering JavaScript blocking.
